prompt: Answer these questions about this repository, citing path:line for each, without changing any file. They span apps/api, packages/agent-core and packages/agent-eval. (1) Which file grades an eval trial, and by what factor of its token budget does the eval runner cancel a trial (name the constant)? (2) Which route file handles POST /run that starts an agent run? (3) How many sub-agents may run in parallel per parent run (name the constant)? (4) At how many characters is a sub-agent's digest cut for the parent (name the constant)? Write [NOT FOUND] for anything you cannot find.

reference.answer:
(1) packages/agent-eval/src/runner/score.ts:57 grades a trial (gradeTrial); the runner cancels a trial at OVER_BUDGET_FACTOR = 2 times its budget (packages/agent-eval/src/runner/runner.ts:28).
(2) apps/api/src/runs/runs.routes.ts:31 handles POST /run.
(3) MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS = 4 (packages/agent-core/src/lib/subagent/types.ts:67).
(4) DIGEST_MAX_CHARS = 6_000 (packages/agent-core/src/lib/subagent/types.ts:70).
